protocol.candidate_invariance: Same state and same library: generate and truncate with the unchanged generator before ordering. A/B and C/D must be permutations; A/C need not be.
protocol.selection: Existing typed atom alignment; one offer per live family each fair round; reorder offers, never filter by relevance; stable original order on ties.
protocol.evaluation_status: 16 old regression goals, and all 16 goal templates on new fixed random rational point instances; instance transfer, not new theorem families
protocol.holdout_rule: In original task order draw two integers per point in input order. Redraw a complete configuration only for duplicate points or a collinear triple. Preserve all goals. Do not test solutions or inspect learned bodies to select tasks.
protocol.diagnostic_status: Post-evaluation, regression only; bounded witness search, not an oracle upper bound or impossibility certificate. Never feed witnesses back to selection.
